transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess… I’ve just been feeling like I messed everything up. Work, my apartment… it feels like I’ve fallen behind and lost control, and that it’s my fault. Like I deserve whatever happens next.
Have you noticed that you don't enjoy things as much as you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you once liked?
Yeah… I guess so. Most days I wake up with this kind of flat, heavy sadness. Stuff that used to help—music, cooking, messing around with electronics—it just… doesn’t really reach me anymore.
Have you been having trouble sleeping, or have you found yourself sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah… sleeping’s been bad. I’ll lie there a long time, just kind of listening to noises in the apartment. Then when I finally do sleep, I’m up before it’s really morning, already tense… like I didn’t actually rest.
Have you noticed feeling more tired or lacking energy, even if you haven’t done much during the day?
I don’t know… maybe a little, but I haven’t really been paying attention to it. It’s hard to tell.
Have you found it harder to focus, make decisions, or think clearly lately?
I’m not sure. I mean… maybe I’m a little slower with things, but I haven’t really noticed it enough to say. Decisions are just… decisions, I guess.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or unable to sit still?

Yeah… maybe slower, I guess. At work I’ll catch myself just sitting there with my hands over the keyboard, like I know it’s a simple ticket, but it takes me longer to actually type anything. Like there’s a delay between my head and my hands.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or ending your life?
Not… not like a plan or anything. I’m not trying to hurt myself. But sometimes I think it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up… like nobody would have to deal with me anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I guess… a little over a year. Maybe about fourteen months. It started after that pipe burst and I had to move into the smaller place. Things kind of fell apart after that.
Have you had any periods lasting at least a couple of weeks where you felt noticeably better or closer to your usual self during this time?

Not really, no. It’s been pretty steady… maybe about a year and two months now, since the pipe burst and I had to move into the smaller place. I don’t think I’ve had a couple weeks where I felt like myself again.
